spans.s: 1. ज the 3rd palatal letter (having the sound of j in jump).
2. ज mf(आ)n. (√ जन्) ifc. born or descended from, produced or caused by, born or produced in or at or upon, growing in, living at, Mn.; MBh. &c.
(after an adv. or adverbial word) born or produced (e.g. अग्र-, अवर-; एक-, द्वि-, नि-, पूर्व-, प्रथम-, सह- and साकं-ज॑), Mn. x, 25
prepared from, made of or with, v, 25; Suśr.; Hcat.
‘belonging to, connected with, peculiar to’, see अनूप, अन्न, शह्र-, सार्थ-.
(Ved. for 2. ज cf. Pāṇ. iii, 2, 67) ifc. ‘born, produced’, see अग्र-, अद्रि-, अप्सु-जा॑ &c.
(आ॑स्), m. f. offspring, pl. descendants, RV.
